Environment

Provides the scene and its current state.

Camera configuration

The example requests 640 × 480 RGB at a 1/30-second update period. Lens and renderer settings determine the camera view.

ovrtx renderer

ovrtx renders the current scene from the requested camera pose and returns RGB images.

Camera sensor

The camera sensor connects its configured view and update timing to rendering, then exposes the resulting image data.

Observations

Camera images available to the policy.
